aggregation: positive witness > incomplete/empty scope > observed negative; DELIVERY_RISK and CAPACITY_PRESSURE have explicit overrides
capacity_v1_policy: UNKNOWN only; no fabricated utilization proxy

limitations.C03_ACCOUNTING_NOT_RELEASE: Failed-quantity accounting does not establish formal quality release or a specific disposition.
limitations.C03_ASSOCIATION_NOT_ALLOCATION: Material/time association does not establish order-specific procurement allocation.
limitations.C03_CAPACITY_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: An order-centric snapshot lacks complete competing workload, shift calendars, and allocatable capacity.
limitations.C03_CLOSED_WORLD_OBSERVATION_ASSUMPTION: Absence means absence in the admitted C02 synthetic observation scope; late-arriving real-world records are not modeled.
limitations.C03_INACTIVE_NOT_ALL_CLEAR: INACTIVE denotes absence of the specified indicator in the admitted observation scope, not an all-clear business decision.
limitations.C03_INSPECTION_NOT_RELEASE: An inspection result does not establish a formal release event.
limitations.C03_NOT_MATERIAL_AVAILABILITY: This timing warning does not establish net stock, material consumption, or production-time availability.
limitations.C03_OBSERVED_HISTORY_NOT_CURRENT_CAUSE: A recorded historical warning may persist after resolution and must not be described as a current causal impediment.
limitations.C03_REWORK_NOT_RELEASE: Recorded rework does not establish formal quality release.
limitations.C03_RULE_BASED_NOT_CAUSAL: This is a versioned rule indicator, not causal or root-cause evidence.
limitations.C03_RULE_INDICATOR_NOT_FORECAST: The rule is a deterministic commitment warning, not a calibrated forecast or probability.
limitations.C03_SCOPE_PARTIALLY_OBSERVED: Some rule-relevant scope lacks required evidence; a positive witness does not resolve the remaining uncertainty.
limitations.C03_START_SLIPPAGE_NOT_QUEUE_MEASUREMENT: Planned-versus-observed start slippage is not measured queue residence time; the plan availability includes the C02 synthetic proxy.

quantity_arithmetic: int or finite Decimal, no float/coercion

CAPACITY_PRESSURE.scope: Real work-center capacity pressure is not identifiable from the C02 order-centric input. v1 intentionally abstains.
CAPACITY_PRESSURE.unknown_statement: Real capacity pressure is unknown because the order-centric input does not establish complete competing workload, shift calendars, or allocatable capacity.

DELIVERY_RISK.active_statement: The delivery commitment is overdue with remaining quantity, or an incomplete work-order plan ends after that commitment; this is a deterministic warning, not a delivery probability or causal attribution.
DELIVERY_RISK.scope: Unfulfilled overdue commitment or an incomplete work-order plan ending after the commitment. Not a probabilistic forecast.
DELIVERY_RISK.unknown_statement: The available observations do not support a delivery forecast before fulfillment or a defined commitment warning.

MATERIAL_TIMING_RISK.active_statement: A purchase order associated by material has a timing warning relative to a requirement need-by time; this does not prove a material shortage or an order-specific allocation.
MATERIAL_TIMING_RISK.scope: A material/time-associated procurement warning relative to requirement need-by, not net material shortage or availability proof.
MATERIAL_TIMING_RISK.unknown_statement: The available requirement and associated procurement records do not establish the material-timing indicator.

QUALITY_DISPOSITION_UNKNOWN.active_statement: The versioned failed-quantity accounting leaves a positive disposition gap; the disposition is unknown and no scrap, replacement, concession, or release is inferred.
QUALITY_DISPOSITION_UNKNOWN.scope: Positive unexplained failed quantity under the frozen C02 arithmetic; separate from universal lack of a formal release event.
QUALITY_DISPOSITION_UNKNOWN.unknown_statement: The available evidence is insufficient to determine a failed-quantity disposition gap.

QUALITY_FAILURE.active_statement: At least one eligible inspection records a positive failed quantity; this observation does not establish formal quality-release status.
QUALITY_FAILURE.scope: At least one admitted inspection records positive failed quantity, not formal release status.
QUALITY_FAILURE.unknown_statement: Eligible inspection evidence is insufficient to determine the recorded-quality-failure indicator.

QUEUE_DELAY.active_statement: A recorded operation started after its planned start or has not recorded a start by an overdue planned-start time; this is a start-slippage proxy, not a measured queue duration or a causal capacity finding.
QUEUE_DELAY.scope: Operation start slippage against its recorded planned start; an explicitly limited proxy, not measured queue residence time.
QUEUE_DELAY.unknown_statement: Eligible operation timing evidence is insufficient to determine the start-slippage proxy.

REWORK_PRESENT.active_statement: Eligible rework has been recorded; this does not imply that it is still in progress or that formal quality release has occurred.
REWORK_PRESENT.scope: Recorded eligible rework exists as of the cutoff, including completed rework; not a claim that rework is still in progress.
REWORK_PRESENT.unknown_statement: The available observation scope is insufficient to determine recorded rework presence.

SUPPLIER_LATE_RECEIPT.active_statement: Associated procurement records contain receipt lateness or overdue outstanding quantity; they do not establish target-order allocation or causation.
SUPPLIER_LATE_RECEIPT.scope: Observed PurchaseOrder receipt lateness in the target material-associated PO set, not proof of target-order supplier causation.
SUPPLIER_LATE_RECEIPT.unknown_statement: Associated procurement evidence is insufficient to determine the receipt-lateness indicator.
